3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The moment was punctuated by the arrival of a member of the Golden Guard. He was wearing a ceremonial breastplate that gleamed under the room's warm lights.

4.speaker: Hugo Toras
4.text: "War is a crucible. If you can face it head-on and survive, you will be unbreakable."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "We must also remember the toll conflict takes on our people. History should recall the hearts and spirits of those brave commoners sent to fight for their kingdom."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "But what if it's all too much? What if I fail?"

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "The Lord is on our side. Our victory will not only be a testament to our strength but also to our faith and righteousness."

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "'Crucible' is a fitting word for it. I will lead our kingdom to battle with an iron fist. All will know Rizia's might."

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "I hoped it would never come to this. But if we must weather the storm of war, I shall do my best to steer Rizia through it."

13.speaker: Vina Toras
13.text: "Still, the people need compassion now more than ever."

14.speaker: Estela Toras
14.text: "If only historians shared your compassion, darling."

19.speaker: Estela Toras
19.text: "Because you've learned from your predecessors' mistakes."

20.speaker: Vina Toras
20.text: "It's a heavy burden, but one that we'll share as a family. And as a nation."

21.speaker: Vina Toras
21.text: "It was your choice to go to war, Father. You've got to bear the burden."
21.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

25.speaker: Estela Toras
25.text: "But it's the kings they pay attention to. Their triumphs -- and their failures."

29.speaker: Vina Toras
29.text: "I wish I could've done more to prevent this."
29.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: Next to him, my mother nodded silently. She looked troubled.

41.speaker: Vina Toras
41.text: "Prayer won't help the death we're about to unleash, Father."
41.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

45.speaker: Estela Toras
45.text: "Such ferocity, son. Save some for the populace out there."

52.speaker: Vina Toras
52.text: "We shouldn't charge headlong into battle. No one will be safe from the consequences."

53.speaker: Vina Toras
53.text: "The iron fist has never brought good things for our people."
53.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

54.speaker: Estela Toras
54.text: "Just be careful not to lose your own footing."

61.speaker: Vina Toras
61.text: "Calm and thoughtful leadership is what Rizia needs right now."

62.speaker: Vina Toras
62.text: "All these metaphors are making me seasick. I just hope history doesn't repeat itself."
62.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

63.speaker: Hugo Toras
63.text: "Compassion is noble, but it must not overshadow the need for decisive action in times of war."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "I disagree. If we lose our moral compass, then we lose everything."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "Decisiveness is key. But I won't let it harden our kingdom's heart."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "You're right. It's up to me to make the tough but necessary decisions."

67.speaker: Hugo Toras
67.text: "Two and a half million people have gathered outside. Our entire police force is deployed for their safety."
67.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false)

68.speaker: Hugo Toras
68.text: "The Golden Guard will ensure the palace and its surroundings remain secure."

69.speaker: Hugo Toras
69.text: "I suspect it was always going to come to this, Your Highness. You shouldn't blame yourself."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Exactly. You were lucky to get out of there alive."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "If anything, it was my actions that led us to this point. But now that we've set ourselves on this path, we can't turn back."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "There's no use lamenting what could have been. We've got to concentrate on what comes next."

73.speaker: Hugo Toras
73.text: "Your solidarity is admirable, Your Highness, but there are some decisions your father will have to make on his own."

74.speaker: Hugo Toras
74.text: "The mantle of leadership is a solitary one. But the choices you make will affect every living soul in this kingdom."

75.speaker: Hugo Toras
75.text: "We will not win this war without faith, Your Highness. But it must be combined with clear-headed strategy."

76.speaker: Hugo Toras
76.text: "For as long as I live, our family will be safe."

77.speaker: Hugo Toras
77.text: "Strength is a tool, Your Highness. One that can be valuable if used judiciously."

78.speaker: Hugo Toras
78.text: "Precisely, Your Highness. We don't want our kingdom to be perceived as the aggressor."

79.speaker: Hugo Toras
79.text: "Facing Pales is our chance to correct past mistakes, not repeat them."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Thank you nonetheless, Vina. I'll never turn away from the wisdom of my family and council."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "It's all part and parcel of being king. I was born to rule alone."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Only I can protect our nation in these trying times."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "The weight of this war rests solely on me, a responsibility I must accept for Rizia's safety."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "We need to defend our kingdom's sovereignty and future."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Our faith will bolster us, but our strategy against Pales will be pragmatic and calculated."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "It is Rizia's destiny to reunite with Pales. If we pray enough, we will manifest our victory."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "My head is clearer than it's ever been. I know God will show us the way forward."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "We seek comfort in prayer, but our decisive actions will be what protects Rizia from the Palesian menace."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "The Palesians brought this on themselves. They deserve all the destruction we can rain down on them."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "The Palesians have given us no choice, Vina. It's now or never."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "I swear on my own life that no harm shall befall the Toras family."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "We aren't bound by our past as we confront Pales. We will forge a new path for Rizia."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Our strength will be a shield, not a weapon of oppression."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "I will do what I must to protect our people. No matter how painful the decision."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Our history with Pales is a guide. We'll use it to avoid repeating old errors."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "In war, we shall remain calm, our actions swift and decisive."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "But we don't want to be seen as weaklings, either."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Controlled strength. That's what I'm aiming for in this speech."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I know exactly what my father did wrong. I'll never fall into the same traps he did."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "We won't repeat history, we'll rewrite it. Starting today."

102.speaker: Hugo Toras
102.text: "I have been outside. The atmosphere is tense, yet there's an undeniable sense of solidarity among our people."

103.speaker: Hugo Toras
103.text: "Look at how prepared we are, Madam Queen Mother. Our armies will not falter."

104.speaker: Estela Toras
104.text: "I remember this feeling from all the way back in 1923. And I remember what happened next..."

105.speaker: Estela Toras
105.text: "Listen to me, Romus. We can't lose to Pales again."

109.speaker: Hugo Toras
109.text: "We will learn and adapt from what happened back then. Our will shall guide us."

116.speaker: Vina Toras
116.text: "I just hope that less blood will be spilled than during the Reclamation War."

117.speaker: Vina Toras
117.text: "I just hope that we can find a peaceful resolution to this. Sooner rather than later."
117.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: The rhythmic cadence of countless voices echoed outside.

119.speaker: Hugo Toras
119.text: "Pacifying the Palesian populace will lead to the least harm. That is our goal."

120.speaker: Hugo Toras
120.text: "The Palesians don't want peace, Your Highness. Furthering the cycle of violence allows them to garner more support from their Lespian backers."

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: He relayed to Hugo that all was prepared. The time had come to address the Kingdom, to define the future of Rizia at war.

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "We'll aim to pacify Pales, but not at the expense of our humanity."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "Pacification should not mean oppression. We'll ensure fairness in our approach."

124.speaker: Estela Toras
124.text: "Choose your words carefully, son. This speech isn't just about the war; it's about rallying the Rizian people in the face of adversity."
124.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false)

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "Our goal is peace, but we must be ready for resistance."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "I am confident that Duke Reinhart wants a swift end to the war, just as I do."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "We are not going to fall into that trap. We'll choose the path of peace at all costs."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "We're facing a harsh reality. We must be ready for whatever violence comes."

129.speaker: Estela Toras
129.text: "Just don't forget that less-than-decisive action on our part risks drawing out the conflict further and losing more lives."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "You're right, Mother. This speech is a call to unity, a reminder that we are stronger together."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "It's a chance to remind them what they'll be fighting for. What they'll be dying for."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "I'll use this speech to lift our people's spirits. Rizia will only win this war if they believe we can."

134.speaker: Hugo Toras
134.text: "Everything has been prepared for you. Would you like any of us to be by your side on the balcony?"

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "You are all family. I want you by my side."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Princess Vina represents the future. She should be with me."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Our Queen Mother should be next to me to show that we survived the past tribulations."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "You should be with me, Hugo. As my uncle and my trusted second-in-command."

145.speaker: Hugo Toras
145.text: "We stand with you, Romus. United, as a family should be in such times."

147.speaker: Hugo Toras
147.text: "Then together, the Royal Family shall present a united front to the world."

149.speaker: Hugo Toras
149.text: "The entire division of the Golden Guard has been deployed, ensuring the city center is a safe zone."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Mother, Uncle, I want you both with me during this pivotal moment."

151.speaker: Estela Toras
151.text: "Your father would be proud. We'll face this together, as we always have."

152.speaker: Hugo Toras
152.text: "It would be an honor to stand beside you, my nephew."

157.speaker: Estela Toras
157.text: "That's true. The lower the morale, the higher the casualties."

158.speaker: Estela Toras
158.text: "As long as we don't get lost in the same darkness that Valero did."

159.speaker: Estela Toras
159.text: "A swift end is great, as long as you're on the winning side."

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "This burden is mine to bear. I will make the speech alone."

161.speaker: Hugo Toras
161.text: "We'll be with you in spirit, every step of the way."

162.speaker: Estela Toras
162.text: "Good luck out there. Don't forget to enunciate."

165.speaker: Hugo Toras
165.text: "Indeed. Queen Mother Estela shall remind the public of the history we have weathered together."

166.speaker: Estela Toras
166.text: "If only Valero could be here to see the two of you together."

176.speaker: Vina Toras
176.text: "Yes, good luck, Father. We'll be here if you need us."

177.speaker: Vina Toras
177.text: "Yes, of course. It's my duty and my privilege to stand with the King."

185.speaker: Vina Toras
185.text: "If that's what you want, so be it. I will stand with you, for Rizia."

189.speaker: Vina Toras
189.text: "I'll stand with you. The people need to know their princess is with them."

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: My mother put a firm hand on my shoulder.

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: My mother kissed me on the cheek.

196.speaker: Estela Toras
196.text: "In other words, I'm old. No need to sugar-coat it, Hugo."
